title: Add Library
description: Scaffold a shared library under libs/<scope>/<name>.

name.description: Library name (kebab-case). Nx project name is <scope>-<name>.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the library?

scope.description: Folder under libs/ and project-name prefix (default: shared; ionic for ionic libs; flutter for flutter libs).

dir.description: Folders under libs/<scope>/ for the library (kebab-case names separated by "/", at most 2, e.g. forms): the lib goes to libs/<scope>/<dir>/<name>.

variant.description: angular/ionic: internal | buildable | publishable (default: buildable). state: simple-service | ngrx (default: simple-service); state libs are always buildable.

standalone.description: angular/ionic/pii/session/state: standalone components, directives and pipes and provide*() functions instead of NgModules. Default: the workspace's nx.json pstack.angular.style, else NgModules.

module.description: angular/ionic/pii/session/state: NgModules even when the workspace default is standalone.
